identity.title: Toolkit-free host ports for Argus actions, snapshots, capture and the UI heartbeat

context_capsule.purpose_for_a_reader_without_history: Model steering, live snapshots, screenshots, author ids, the MCP wire layer and the Palmistry heartbeat run on toolkit-free ports, so the new shell keeps the same model and watcher routes and both hosts can be checked with one conformance suite.

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: Parallel Operator and model clients MUST have attributable, recoverable interaction routes. One client's view, selection or navigation MUST NOT silently replace another client's focus, active context or work.

Actual new GUI actions, navigation, component states and errors, including Vulkan backend and centralized GPU memory/lifetime failures, MUST be observable through the existing internal_diagnostics producer/API and its typed mechanical allowlist.
Palmistry MUST remain a STANDALONE OUT-OF-PROCESS watcher and event recorder for later diagnostics, preserving section 6.13 lifecycle inversion

closure_unit.outcome: Model steering, live snapshots, screenshots, author ids, the MCP wire layer and the Palmistry heartbeat run on toolkit-free ports, so the new shell keeps the same model and watcher routes and both hosts can be checked with one conformance suite.

materialized_acceptance.text: Closure: action, snapshot, capture, heartbeat, author-id and wire crates compile without egui, eframe, egui-winit, egui-wgpu, egui_tiles, epaint, ecolor, emath, egui_kittest, kumihimo-egui, cabinet-egui, cabinet-peak-egui, handshake_context_menu_egui, wgpu, wgpu-core, wgpu-hal, glow and expose no toolkit type; the egui host keeps thin adapters over them and the new shell has its own adapters.

Wire compatibility: argus.inspect, argus.click, argus.set_value, argus.screenshot and every other registered method keep their request and response JSON; one conformance suite runs against both hosts and passes on both.

Snapshot is taken from the live tree of the presented frame: bounds and viewport come from the real window (physical and logical pixels, scale, window id), root and detached, with a typed no-frame-yet state; the isolated egui::Context path (app.rs:13290) is not used by the new shell.

Actions are revalidated against the live tree at execution, carry agent_label, session, correlation and lease, never overwrite Operator input in the same frame (reject_queued_for_operator_input semantics kept) and return a receipt with the observed effect.

Capture is a Vulkan readback of the presented frame of the named window through an MT-203 claim with asynchronous settlement, carries renderer identity, revision, region and content hash, is permission-bound as today, and never blocks the UI thread or uses OS screen capture on the new shell.

Heartbeat: a UI-thread timer independent of redraw publishes counter and monotonic nanos through diag_ring write_heartbeat at least every 250 ms while the loop is alive, wait-free and allocation-free, silent without a ring writer; a background thread never publishes it, so a blocked UI thread goes stale.

Author ids: one host-supplied grammar policy accepts every existing id, rejects duplicates across the composed tree, and maps to AccessKit node ids; no existing id is renamed. The survey of existing constants and the measured rejection count under the Kumihimo grammar are recorded.

Focus audit covers every shell, port, gate and test root (src and tests), not handshake_native/src only, and fails on SetForegroundWindow, BringWindowToTop, SetActiveWindow, SetFocus, keybd_event, mouse_event, SendInput or equivalents outside the declared allow-list.
Bounds: queues, snapshots, retained captures and receipts have explicit limits with typed overflow; nothing holds a lock across a blocking wait.
internal_diagnostics: each outcome maps to the existing GuiDiagnosticOperation/Phase and DiagEventCode allowlist; a missing code is requested as a typed addition, never worked around with text.

Toolkit-free Palmistry launcher: resolving and starting the existing standalone Palmistry watcher, binding the v2 diagnostics ring nonce and runtime-instance lease, the signed ready handshake, child liveness registration and shutdown request with acknowledgement are one crate under src/frontend/handshake_host_ports/palmistry_launch that compiles without egui, eframe, wgpu, glow and without the handshake-native crate, and exposes no toolkit type. The egui host keeps diagnostics/palmistry_launch.rs as a thin re-export so every existing module path and retained selector (including signed_launch_evidence_tests and test_palmistry_launch) runs unchanged. No launch order, wire, signing, timing, ring-layout or watcher behaviour changes; no new watcher, ring or recorder.

implementation_steps.step: S1 (first coding slice): ui_heartbeat crate. A port trait plus a monotonic timer helper driven by the host loop, calling diag_ring write_heartbeat; unit tests for monotonicity, allocation-free path, no-ring no-op and a stale counter when the loop is blocked. The egui host is untouched.
S2: author_ids crate: host grammar policy, duplicate detection, node-id mapping; survey test over every existing id constant.
S3: semantic_snapshot crate: move the snapshot data types and JSON; live-tree provider trait with viewport source; egui adapter keeps today's output byte-for-byte.
S4: action_port crate: UiAction, outcomes, receipts, queue and revalidation over the provider trait; egui adapter stays in the host.
S5: frame_capture crate: request and receipt types, provider trait, Vulkan readback provider over MT-214 surface and an MT-203 claim.
S6: mcp_wire crate: server, session, leases, attribution, binding and tool dispatch without toolkit types (needs MT-212 release); both hosts consume it.
S7: focus_audit target over every GUI root, then the conformance suite against both hosts.

S8: palmistry_launch crate: move the launcher; replace the `super::DiagSession` parameter with a small port type owned by the new crate (session id, process instance id, runtime-instance fields) that the egui host's DiagSession implements; keep the egui file as re-export; run the existing launch tests unchanged in the egui host plus a conformance test that the shell adapter and the egui host start the same watcher with the same v2 nonce. The ShutdownWatcher adapter for the shell is MT-214 work.

hbr_obligations.obligation_or_reason: Ports draw nothing; the surfaces mount through MT-214 and MT-199.
Each control and action declared once with a stable id that feeds GUI, AccessKit, Argus and UserManual.
All GPU work through the MT-203 owner: admission, budget, retained accounting, exactly-once release, typed loss.
Every cache, queue and buffer bounded and accounted, with overload, cancel, stale-revision and release behaviour.
GUI actions, states, errors and GPU failures through the existing internal_diagnostics allowlist, content-free.
Palmistry survives an owned freeze and an owned crash of the real application with the surface mounted.
Every command carries actor/session, command id, revision and correlation; correlation grants nothing.
Shared edges, dividers, keyboard, focus, IME, AccessKit, DPI, multiwindow, recovery and truthful states.
Validator drives the running surface through Argus (stable author_id, no foreground).
Renderer error scan on every captured frame: Vulkan validation messages and runtime errors; any error fails.
Capture matrix: normal, constrained viewport, and empty/error/loading/multi-item states.
Port behaviour is inspected through the conformance suite and receipts.
A surface Argus cannot see or steer is repaired in this MT or recorded as a blocking gap.
Automated runs use a quiet, never-activated window or offscreen frame; zero focus or Z-order change.
No OS input injection, cursor movement or foregrounding on any path, tests included.
Background launches record owner and are reclaimed; no orphan windows or processes.
A step that needs the foreground (real OS IME typing) is declared first and run by the Operator.
Three-tier diagnostic outcome recorded per tier (hbr_int_009_tier_obligations).
One owning module in execution.module_ref; write scope derives from its roots; dependency direction stated.
Warm rebuild time and relinked test binaries recorded for the candidate.
Mechanic consumed from its single existing owner (context_capsule.consumed_capability_refs).
No new canonical mechanic without a spec primitive and an owner search.
Accountable owner and independently selectable source, dependency, build, test and artifact closure.
Exact embedding adapter; host policy stays in Handshake.
Handshake-owned host ports; no asset change.
Missing shared logic is added to the asset first; no host workaround, copy or fork.
Scope linkage preserved on every projected resource.
Default deny kept for missing, stale or revoked context at every boundary touched.
Concurrent accounts see neither content nor existence metadata of each other.
Logout, switch or revocation clears or fences caches, captures, snapshots and stale UI state.
Concurrent agents plus Operator edits: no silent last-writer-wins; conflicts are typed.
Cargo target under the one artifact root, owner-scoped, named in the dispatch (KB-OUT-008).
Owner cleans only its own scoped artifact folder.
UserManual updated in the same change; MANUAL_VERSION bumped where declared.
A no-context model can operate the surface from the manual alone.
Manual entries are code-truthful and self-consistency tested.
